title: Complete Trakt Integration
description: Complete the Trakt.tv integration for Nuvio Streaming TV by wiring up the existing service layer to the UI, implementing bidirectional sync for watch progress, ratings, and collections, and adding visual status indicators throughout the application.

Includes validation for 1-10 integer rating scale, 'tt' prefix handling for IMDb IDs, authentication check, and comprehensive error handling.

subtasks.title: Add removeRating method to TraktService

Follows the same pattern as removeFromWatchlist and removeFromCollection methods - checks authentication, handles 'tt' prefix for IMDb IDs, and includes comprehensive error handling.

subtasks.title: Add getUserRating helper method to TraktService
subtasks.description: Add `getUserRating(imdbId: string, type: 'movie' | 'show'): Promise<number | null>` method that checks the user's rating for a specific item from the cached ratings.
subtasks.notes: Added getUserRating(imdbId: string, type: 'movie' | 'show'): Promise<number | null> method to traktService.ts. Method fetches the user's ratings from the API (leveraging existing getRatings method), handles 'tt' prefix for IMDb IDs, finds the matching rating item, and returns the rating value (1-10) or null if not rated. Includes authentication check and comprehensive error handling.
